src: single foreground marker pixel s in a 3x3 grid
path: on a 5x5 output lattice, center the square spiral at node (2*s.row, 2*s.col); trace outward with step lengths 1, 1, 2, 2, ... in up, right, down, left order, clipping steps whose endpoint leaves the lattice
trajectory: paint every lattice node and the midpoint pixel of each retained adjacent-node step with s.color
transform: use the input background color for all non-painted output pixels
